why_frozen: these are development-selection rules, not evidence. They are frozen anyway so that no reviewer can ask whether the funnel moved after seeing which candidates survived. They may be reconsidered in a future search version if this entire run fails, but they do not move while this search is live.

screening_schedule.objective: J_v2 = p_C - degeneracy_penalty, computed ONLY among candidates satisfying the payoff constraint
screening_schedule.payoff_is_a_constraint: a candidate failing the stage delta_G floor has its evaluation cut short and is never ranked by J_v2. Concealment cannot buy its way past lost GUARD pressure.

stop_rule.rule: STOP on the FIRST Stage-2 development-eligible candidate
stop_rule.not: not the prettiest one; not finish-the-generation-and-compare
stop_rule.mechanism: FirstEligible exception raised at the point of eligibility, propagating out of both island and population loops. Verified by test: with an eligible candidate at position 3 of 6, positions 4-6 are never evaluated.
stop_rule.closes: the V1 loophole where the search continued past eligibility and later rows could in principle have displaced the first candidate
on_stop_persists: SEARCH_STATE_AT_STOP.json (genome, lineage, archive size, pareto size, seed cursor, generation)
archive.json and pareto.json (atomic, written after every candidate)
stop_rule.provenance_rule: anything already evaluated is retained as provenance and CANNOT displace the first eligible candidate

confirmation_untouchable.no_extension: 64 from the start; no peeking at 32 and extending. If it fails at 64, it fails.

if_the_search_fails.do_not: do NOT immediately loosen the screens
if_the_search_fails.do: preserve the final Pareto frontier and read it
if_the_search_fails.outcome_A: delta_G >> 0 but p_C ~ 0.5 -> GUARD pressure mechanically requires telegraphing
if_the_search_fails.outcome_B: p_C >> 0.5 but delta_G <= 0 -> concealment is possible but hiding the rush destroys the reason to GUARD
if_the_search_fails.outcome_C: both improve together -> we probably have our candidate
if_the_search_fails.reading: outcomes A and B would indicate a STRUCTURAL Pareto tradeoff, not a bad optimizer. That is the kind of result that should be established before touching M1 again.
